signature.name: Kingdom Centre
signature.detail: Riyadh's most recognizable skyscraper, with a sky bridge offering sweeping views over the city. Go near sunset for the best light; tickets for the sky bridge are sold on site, and modest dress is expected.

signature.name: Diriyah
signature.detail: The historic birthplace of the Saudi state, with mud-brick ruins and a growing cultural district. Visit in the cooler evening hours; the At-Turaif District within Diriyah is a UNESCO site and requires a ticket.

signature.name: Masmak Fortress
signature.detail: A 19th-century castle in the heart of old Riyadh, central to Saudi history. It is free to enter and best visited in the morning; modest dress is advised.

transport: Taxis and ride-hailing $3-8 a trip; metro $1-2
